Definition: from G3713; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:--lust.
BiblicalUsage: Lust here is desire burning out of control. Paul writes that men burned in their lust one toward another, and he names it among the sins that follow when people refuse to keep God in their knowledge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lust is desire turned against God's design, and Romans names it plainly so that I cannot dress it up as love.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
